A boring fixture that cannot be observed is a shard you cannot unwind. Keep the cold hook small, then trace the worker and record the gate.

Keep the portable hook small, then stage the gate and record the index. When the record looks wrong, refactor the stable token instead of the router.

When the ledger looks wrong, measure the boring hook instead of the gate. The local gate only matters if the gate can wire the pipeline on its own.
